1. 
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner he has been falsely implicated owing to prior enmity.
Accordingly, he prays for anticipatory bail.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.
3. Learned Advocate for the victim also opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail and submits petitioner is a civic volunteer and due to his undue influence, FIR was not registered.
He had forcibly violated the victim lady.
4. We have considered the materials on record.
Statement of the victim before Magistrate shows petitioner came to her house when she was alone and forcibly raped her.
Petitioner is a civic volunteer and his undue influence over police administration cannot be ignored.
